title: You NEED To Use LinkedIn Filters
description:
Finding the “right” job means a number of things. Yes, you want to find a job that aligns with your skills and will be fulfilling, but you also want to find a company that shares in your values. LinkedIn’s new feature should help dial that in for the long run because you can now search by “commitments” on LinkedIn. #linkedin #linkedintips #jobsearch #jobsearchtips
